rules: use queue v6.1 canonical 92283-point source for candidate identity
require exact HMLR INSPIRE ID and candidate point inside a unique native EPSG:27700 polygon
accept the three hashed HMLR runtime seeds as support evidence but do not promote canonical runner output without F-host execution receipts
row 61522 authority is Lambeth; prior Merton support routing is superseded and forbidden
require exact returned EA National LIDAR survey lineage before numeric use
keep Time Stamped DTM lineage separate and require returned transform/geoid metadata
require real WCS CoverageId from parsed capabilities before DescribeCoverage/GetCoverage
require actual EA DTM1m raster bytes and actual GeoTIFF transform; provisional 1m cell indices cannot be sampled
require actual current OS Terrain50 archive and TQ39/TQ59/TQ27 member bytes
OS ASCII sampling must use 200x200, 50m, north-first row order and pixel-centre values
OS Terrain50 4m RMSE and EA plus/minus 15cm RMSE are product/dataset quality signals, not parcel-specific confidence
no numeric elevation, height difference or confidence may be written without source bytes
no second task or runner for the same continuation
